body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-030-v25-ui-polish.md (v2.5, builds on SC-027). Presentation and quantity-step changes in src/savvycart/http.py and src/savvycart/static/app.css, README wording (absorbs SC-029). New tests only in tests/test_v25_page.py; in tests/test_v21_page.py and tests/test_v22_page.py only the superseded assertions change (date label, papaya and carrot steps, saving 1331); spec revision 2 also re-baselines numbers only in tests/test_guardrails.py, tests/test_v22_page.py, and tests/test_v2_page.py. No engine, agent, guardrail, pantry, or fixture change. Do not call Gemini in tests. Cut-off 16:00 Colombo (G6); otherwise v2.4 is deployed.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Pantry summaries sit under the item name. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v25_page.py::test_pantry_summary_sits_under_the_item_name -q
2. Add-item quantity matches row quantities. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v25_page.py::test_add_item_quantity_matches_the_row_quantities -q
3. Weighed items snap to 0.5 kg. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v25_page.py::test_weighed_items_snap_to_half_kilos -q
4. Default plan LKR 4,604, saving LKR 1,328. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v25_page.py::test_default_plan_figures_after_half_kilo_steps -q
5. Bill tables: LKR headers, unit price, one price-source line, stacked bills. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v25_page.py::test_bill_tables_show_unit_prices_and_one_price_source_line -q
6. Demo wording consolidated. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v25_page.py::test_demo_wording_is_consolidated -q
7. README describes v2.5. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v25_page.py::test_readme_describes_v25 -q; python scripts/check_judge_readme.py
8. 375px: no sideways scroll, controls 44px except pantry summaries. Verify: Runtime.evaluate in the Cursor browser, evidence in .adlc/evidence/SC-031-p6/
9. Every test passes. Verify: python -m pytest -q
title: v2.5 build: pantry spacing, half-kilo steps, bill tables, demo wording, README
